contraindicacoes.en: Teriparatide injection is contraindicated in patients with a history of severe hypersensitivity to teriparatide or any of the inactive ingredients of Teriparatide injection. Reactions have included anaphylaxis and angioedema [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) , Adverse Reactions ( 6.2 )]. interacoes.en: Digoxin: Transient hypercalcemia may predispose patients to digitalis toxicity ( 5.6 , 7.1 ) 7.1 Digoxin Sporadic case reports have suggested that hypercalcemia may predispose patients to digitalis toxicity. Teriparatide injection may transiently increase serum calcium. Consider the potential onset of signs and symptoms of digitalis toxicity when Teriparatide injection is used in patients receiving digoxin [see Warnings and Precaution ( 5.5 ) and Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )].
interacoes.pt: Digoxina: A hipercalcemia transitória pode predispor os pacientes à toxicidade digitálica ( 5.6 , 7.1 ) 7.1 Digoxina Relatos de casos esporádicos sugeriram que a hipercalcemia pode predispor os pacientes à toxicidade digitálica. A injeção de teriparatida pode aumentar transitoriamente o cálcio sérico. Considere o potencial aparecimento de sinais e sintomas de toxicidade digitálica quando a injeção de teriparatida é usada em pacientes recebendo digoxina [ver Advertências e Precauções (5.5) e Farmacologia Clínica (12.3)].
